# Herb Tranter & Opal Pettigrew

- [Herb Tranter](../character/herb-tranter.md) — Romantically involved with — [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) — since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and observes subtle changes around town, including [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) Pullen's marriage and Odette's plan to move West. She learns from Mrs. Sowerby that her friend [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) is gravely ill with consumption. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde drop off jelly at Aunt Drusilla's home, enduring her unpleasant remarks before continuing on to visit Opal, while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) confides her secret ambition to write a story.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) sits in the garden with Opal, who tearfully confesses her fear of dying and her unfulfilled desires for her life. Shortly after, Opal passes away peacefully in her sleep. Following the funeral, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) walk home discussing death and the afterlife.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIV The Summons
